purpose: Close the two suspects the 2026-09-04 official-protocol replication verdict left standing for the Tier-1 gap (60.0 against a published 92.4), without touching the protocol, which is now the released code mirrored string for string. Cell T1-official-pop-500 removes the ROSTER difference: 500 tier-1 queries drawn uniformly from the release's OWN tier-1 population (first successful speaker of every one of the 2,146 query directories) instead of 50 mixed-speaker rows. Cell W-official-raw-yaml removes the SYSTEM-PROMPT WHITESPACE ambiguity: the same frozen 400 and the same request as the sealed R-official-raw cell, with the four system-prompt sentences in the YAML block-scalar spelling configs/example_config.yaml carries instead of the adapter's in-code single-space default. Quantization (Q4_K_M vs bf16) is the third suspect and is a separate preregistered probe, not this flight. Preregistration: docs/readiness/2026-09-04-a2t-tier1-official-population-v1-preregistration.md.

A2T-TIER1-OFFICIAL-POP-500.strata: tier1_direct only; domain mix smart_home 368 / wearables 91 / smart_car 41
A2T-TIER1-OFFICIAL-POP-500.selection: the released tier-1 population (first successful speaker of each of the 2,146 query_* directories), sampled uniformly without replacement, seed 20260803, via random.Random(seed).sample over the population in ascending manifest-id order. max_samples was NOT used: the release orders every subset smart_home -> wearables -> smart_car, so the first 500 sorted directories would be a pure smart_home sample.
A2T-TIER1-OFFICIAL-POP-500.estimand: tier-1 tool accuracy on the release's own tier-1 population, estimated from a uniform 500-query sample

A2T-CALIBRATION-400.strata: 50 samples per tier across all eight Audio2Tool tiers
A2T-CALIBRATION-400.selection: the frozen 400 split, no draw; already exposed by A0 and by both 2026-09-04 flights. Reusing it is what makes the whitespace cell a PAIRED contrast against the sealed R-official-raw manifest at zero additional population cost.
A2T-CALIBRATION-400.estimand: equal-tier reporting, with the natural construction mixture reported beside it as a reweighting

cells.factor: roster: the release's own tier-1 population instead of 50 mixed-speaker rows
cells.factor_a_output_contract: unchanged from R-official-raw: the published system message (the adapter's hard-coded default prompt, the fixed '## Available Tools:' header, and format_tools_compact over the whole 152-row registry)
cells.user_turn: audio first, then the fixed sentence 'Convert this voice command to a tool call.'
cells.serving_geometry: -c 49152 -np 2, 24,576 tokens per slot; one slot fewer than R-official-raw solely because the released tier-1 population contains a 654.6325 s wav

cells.factor: system-prompt whitespace: the configs/example_config.yaml block-scalar spelling instead of the adapter's in-code single-space default
cells.factor_a_output_contract: the published system message with the YAML variant's newline-separated, trailing-newline system_prompt (sha256 aa2e344ee52c59019b938926f37498e0dc9c80bd01f6521eba5c3d81309a491d)
cells.user_turn: audio first, then the fixed sentence 'Convert this voice command to a tool call.'
cells.serving_geometry: -c 49152 -np 3, 16,384 tokens per slot -- byte-identical serving to the sealed R-official-raw cell, which is what makes the contrast a contrast in whitespace alone

shared_protocol.harness: core.flight.FlightRuntime with the shared rails zero-supply direct arm and the OpenJiuwen executor, entered through scripts/flights/run_calibration_cell.py -- the same harness and the same entry point every calibration and replication cell flew
shared_protocol.per_cell_dataset_fragment: the two cells fly two different rosters, so each is launched with its own --dataset; the runner composes model + dataset + baseline + experiment per cell exactly as before

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: 500 rows (T1-official-pop-500) + 400 rows (W-official-raw-yaml) x 1 contact each = 900, plus 8 canaries = 908; the budget is enforced RUN-CUMULATIVELY across both cells' attempts under this run id, and the registered exposure ceiling is 950
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 1,668.914042 + 2,159.688 = 3,828.602042 s for one pass of each cell, rounded up to the integer contracts.ExecutionPlan requires and then to 3,900; the registered exposure ceiling is 4,000
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: 1.5; R-official-raw flew 400 raw rows in 429 s of generation at 0.782 s per call at -np 3, and this flight is 900 rows across two geometries with one 654 s encode. The registered ceiling is 2.0
execution_plan_basis.ceilings_live_in_the_exposure_row: contracts.ExecutionPlan carries no ceiling field; the registered ceilings are the exposure-ledger row's calls / speech audio seconds / gpu hours cells, which the gate requires to be at least these planned values

metrics: official parameter precision/recall/F1, macro over samples as the published code computes it
parameter F1 micro-pooled, reported beside the macro figure
a2t-toolcall-v2 ordered tool accuracy, exact match and slot F1 under the extended parse
mandatory_slices: T1-official-pop-500: tool accuracy, exact match and parameter F1 with a Wilson CI90 at n = 500, against the paper's 92.4 / 92.4; plus the same three by domain (smart_home / wearables / smart_car), reported natural-mixture and equal-domain
T1-official-pop-500 against the frozen 400's own tier-1 50 rows, so the roster effect is visible as a difference rather than a replacement
W-official-raw-yaml: all eight tiers with the paper row and a Wilson CI90 beside every tier
W-official-raw-yaml paired against the sealed R-official-raw manifest, same 400 rows, official scorer on both
official scorer versus the extended a2t-toolcall-v2 on the same outputs, per tier, with the rule behind any gap larger than 3 points named
parse rate and the count of rows whose response named more than one call

decision.owner_alignment_standard: 2026-09-04 owner directive: aligned means within 3 points of the official number under both scorers; being better than the official number by more than 3 points is also acceptable.

T1-official-pop-500.aligned: ALIGNED: official tier-1 tool accuracy >= 89.4 (within 3 pp of the paper's 92.4, or better).
T1-official-pop-500.consistent_within_noise: CONSISTENT-WITHIN-NOISE: not ALIGNED, but 92.4 lies inside the Wilson score CI90 for a binomial proportion at n = 500.

W-official-raw-yaml.aligned: ALIGNED: per-tier official tool accuracy within 3 pp of the paper row, or better, on tiers 1, 2, 5 and 6.
W-official-raw-yaml.consistent_within_noise: CONSISTENT-WITHIN-NOISE: not ALIGNED, but the paper value lies inside the tier's Wilson CI90 (n = 50) on all four.
W-official-raw-yaml.reported_regardless: the paired contrast against the sealed R-official-raw manifest over the same 400 rows answers the whitespace question whatever label the tiers earn.

decision.extension_contingency: If T1-official-pop-500 is ALIGNED, a SECOND registered attempt extends the SAME cell to the remaining 1,646 tier-1 queries (roster part 'remainder', receipt flight-roster-receipt-remainder.json) so the reported number is the full official population; it is its own re-registration with its own plan (1,646 rows + 8 canaries) and its own exposure ceiling. If T1-official-pop-500 is not ALIGNED, no extension is flown.
decision.power_note: n = 500 gives a binomial standard error of 1.2 pp at p = 0.92 and 2.2 pp at p = 0.5, so a 3 pp tolerance is larger than the noise and ALIGNED is a meaningful outcome rather than an artefact of a small sample. n = 50 per tier on the whitespace cell keeps the 4-7 pp standard error of the replication flight, which is why that cell's decision is stated as an alignment band with a CI90 fallback and its real information is the paired contrast.
decision.claim_surface: Nothing here is a superiority, generality or Stage-3 claim; the population is discovery data; no knob is tuned on it.
decision.not_authorized: No test contact, no mechanism arm, no Q8_0 flight (that is its own preregistered probe), no training-free policy fit, no edit to the locked SLURP cell.
